cards.name: 道しるべフェロモン
cards.text: 地面へフェロモンを残し、仲間を採餌経路へ導く。
cards.biology_basis: Many ants recruit nestmates with pheromone trails during foraging.

options.text: Mark a reliable route for the current foraging wave.

cards.name: 土中の巣
cards.text: 働きアリが土を掘り、温度と湿度の安定した室を維持する。
cards.biology_basis: Ant colonies excavate and maintain underground chambers and entrances.

options.text: Maintain a safe chamber for the colony.

cards.name: 集団採餌
cards.text: 仲間を食料源へ動員し、見つけた資源を巣へ運ぶ。
cards.biology_basis: Workers recruit nestmates and jointly exploit food resources.

options.text: Bring a shared food find back to the nest.

cards.name: ツムギアリの絹建築
cards.text: 幼虫の絹と協同作業で、生きた葉の巣を織る。
cards.biology_basis: Workers pull leaves together with silk produced by their larvae.

options.text: Weave a protected canopy.

cards.name: ツムギアリの生きた鎖
cards.text: 多数の働きアリが体をつなぎ、葉を引き寄せる鎖を作る。
cards.biology_basis: Workers form pulling and bridging chains to move across gaps and bend leaves.

options.text: Form a chain and extend the route.

fallback_options.text: Gather a small group at the route.

cards.name: カメアリの滑空
cards.text: 落下を操り、捕食者から離れる方向へ滑空する。
cards.biology_basis: Wingless workers steer their descent while falling from the canopy.

options.text: Steer a fall away from a hunter.
Range across the canopy and widen the next evolutionary search.

cards.name: カメアリの生体門
cards.text: 盾形の頭を持つ兵隊が、狭い巣口をふさぐ生きた門になる。
cards.biology_basis: Soldiers use shield-shaped heads as living barricades at nest entrances.

options.text: Seal the entrance with a shield-shaped head.

cards.name: トラップジョーの弾性顎
cards.text: ばね仕掛けの顎を、攻撃にも緊急脱出にも使う。
cards.biology_basis: A latch-spring mandible strikes prey and can propel an ant away from danger.

options.text: Snap at prey or rivals.
Use the snap to launch away.

cards.name: オオズアリの超大型兵隊
cards.text: 特大の頭部を持つ兵隊が生まれ、巣口で侵入者を押し返す。
cards.biology_basis: Some species produce a third, supersoldier worker caste with specialized defenses.

options.text: Deploy an oversized defender.

cards.name: オオズアリの種子粉砕兵
cards.text: 大型兵の顎を、硬い種子の加工へ転用する。
cards.biology_basis: Supersoldiers in this species specialize in seed milling.

options.text: Process a hard seed harvest.

cards.name: ミツツボアリの生体貯蔵
cards.text: 膨らんだ腹部を持つ働きアリが、液体食料を体内に長期間蓄える。
cards.biology_basis: Replete workers store liquid food in their crops for long periods.

options.text: Hide one hand card in a living reserve.
Keep the reserve mobile instead of storing a card.

cards.name: マタベレアリの野戦治療
cards.text: 働きアリが抗菌分泌物を負傷個体の傷へ塗り、感染を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: Workers apply antimicrobial gland secretions to infected wounds and sharply reduce mortality.

options.text: Treat an infected wound.

cards.name: マタベレアリの救護隊列
cards.text: 負傷した仲間を巣へ運び、働き手を将来へ残す。
cards.biology_basis: Returning raiders carry injured nestmates back to the nest after termite fights.

options.text: Carry an injured nestmate home.

cards.name: 爆発アリの最終防衛
cards.text: 粘着性の分泌物を放つ自己犠牲で侵入者を止め、巣を守る。
cards.biology_basis: Minor workers can rupture enlarged gland reservoirs and repel rivals with sticky irritant secretions.

options.text: Rupture a gland to stop an intruder.

cards.name: サシハリアリの強毒
cards.text: 毒液中の成分がナトリウムチャネルへ作用し、長く続く激痛を生む。
cards.biology_basis: Its venom contains poneratoxin-like sodium-channel toxins causing intense prolonged pain.

options.text: Make a rival pay for approaching.
Deter an attack with venom.

cards.name: 菌栽培アリの共生抗菌物質
cards.text: 共生微生物の抗菌物質が菌園寄生者を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: A Pseudonocardia symbiont produces dentigerumycin that inhibits the garden parasite Escovopsis.

options.text: Suppress the garden parasite.

cards.name: ハキリアリの抗菌菌園
cards.text: 共生細菌と腺分泌物が、菌園へ侵入する病原菌の増殖を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: Leafcutting ants use Pseudonocardia and gland secretions against Escovopsis.

options.text: Protect the cultivated crop.

cards.name: ハキリアリの菌類農業
cards.text: 切り取った葉を菌類へ与え、菌の栄養体を食料として利用する。
cards.biology_basis: Workers provision a fungal cultivar with leaves and consume its nutrient-rich structures.

options.text: Harvest cultivated fungal food.

cards.name: 菌栽培アリの口腔下ポケット
cards.text: 感染物を隔離・除去する口器構造で菌園を衛生化する。
cards.biology_basis: The infrabuccal pocket helps sequester and sterilize Escovopsis material.

options.text: Sterilize and remove infected material.

cards.name: サハラギンアリの銀毛
cards.text: 三角形の銀毛が日射を反射し、体温上昇を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: Triangular reflective hairs reduce internal heating under intense sunlight.

options.text: Reflect and radiate desert heat.

cards.name: 砂漠アリの天空コンパス
cards.text: 偏光した空と歩数の積算を手がかりに、目印のない砂漠から帰還する。
cards.biology_basis: Desert foragers use path integration and polarized skylight to return across featureless terrain.

options.text: Discover another option by the shortest known route.

cards.name: オオズアリの迎撃壁
cards.text: 大型兵と働きアリが巣口に集まり、侵入する軍隊アリを段階的に迎え撃つ。
cards.biology_basis: Supermajors and workers use multiple defensive phases against invading army ants.

options.text: Coordinate supermajors at the entrance.

cards.name: ハリアリの繁殖ワーカー
cards.text: ワーカーが繁殖個体へ移行できる柔軟なカーストを持つ。
cards.biology_basis: Workers can reversibly enter a reproductive gamergate caste after queen loss.

options.text: Let a worker become a reproductive option.
Reverse a gene-expression state and return one lower card in this column to hand.

cards.name: ムネボソアリの定足数決定
cards.text: 偵察個体の情報を集め、中央指揮なしで新居を決める。
cards.biology_basis: Scouts recruit nestmates and use quorum-like feedback to choose new nest sites.

options.text: Recruit toward the best available cavity.
Send scouts farther and reveal one extra candidate next round.

cards.name: 収穫アリの地下穀倉
cards.text: 地中の乾いた室へ種子を運び、湿度を調整しながら貯蔵する。発芽した種子も加工し、硬い種子を利用する。
cards.biology_basis: Workers store seeds in damp subterranean chambers and use germination to process large seeds.

options.text: Hide one hand card in a protected seed chamber.
Keep the harvest accessible instead of storing a card.

cards.name: 救助を呼ぶ遭難信号
cards.text: 閉じ込められた個体の化学信号が仲間の救助を呼ぶ。
cards.biology_basis: Mandibular-gland compounds released by trapped workers attract nestmates to dig and rescue them.

options.text: Call nestmates to a trapped worker.

cards.name: ヒアリの乾燥貯蔵
cards.text: ヒアリは獲物の断片を乾かし、巣内へ運んで後で利用する。
cards.biology_basis: Fire ants dry and store insect pieces for later use; honeypot-like storage is an ant adaptation.

options.text: Dry and hide one hand card for a later shortage.
Keep the dried food at hand instead of storing a card.

cards.name: ヒアリ筏の交代運用
cards.text: 筏の位置を交代しながら、長い洪水を耐え抜く。
cards.biology_basis: Workers cycle through floating rafts and protect brood during prolonged flooding.

options.text: Cycle workers through a living raft.
Expose cycling workers to new conditions and reveal one extra candidate next round.

cards.name: ハキリアリの葉片仮置場
cards.text: 運搬した葉片を巣口の外へ一時的に集め、入口が塞がっても菌園への供給を続ける。
cards.biology_basis: Foragers can deposit leaf fragments outside a temporarily blocked nest entrance as a cache.

options.text: Hide one hand card beside the blocked entrance.
Carry the cached leaf onward instead of storing a card.

cards.name: ハキリアリの胞子除去
cards.text: 胞子と汚染部を物理的に取り除き、化学防御を補う。
cards.biology_basis: Workers physically remove Escovopsis spores and mycelium alongside chemical defenses.

options.text: Remove spores and contaminated garden material.

cards.name: 砂漠アリの熱ショック応答
cards.text: 分子シャペロンが、高温下の細胞機能を守る。
cards.biology_basis: Heat-adapted ants show constitutive and inducible molecular chaperone responses to thermal stress.

options.text: Protect cellular machinery during a hot run.

cards.name: マタベレアリのシロアリ襲撃
cards.text: 分業した隊列が防御性の高いシロアリを襲い、獲物を巣へ運ぶ。
cards.biology_basis: This species performs group raids on highly defensive termites, with specialized task division.

options.text: Bring home a coordinated termite harvest.
Keep the raid column together.

cards.name: ムネボソアリの緊急引越し
cards.text: 傷んだ巣を捨て、危険が迫る前に移住する。
cards.biology_basis: Colonies emigrate from fragile cavities when their current nest is damaged or deteriorates.

options.text: Move before the cavity becomes unsafe.
Explore alternate cavities and reveal one extra candidate next round.

cards.name: 黒庭アリの密閉創設
cards.text: 女王が最初の巣室を閉じ、蓄えだけで初期ワーカーを育てる。
cards.biology_basis: Claustral Lasius niger queens raise their first worker generation from stored reserves without foraging.

options.text: Seal a new colony's first chamber.

cards.name: トゲオオハリアリのジェンマ継承
cards.text: 胸部のジェンマを残したワーカーが、繁殖個体へ成長する。
cards.biology_basis: All newly emerged females bear thoracic gemmae; the reproductive worker removes them from nestmates, leaving a future successor with reproductive potential.

options.text: Pass reproductive potential to a successor worker.

cards.name: 無王アリのクローン監視
cards.text: クローンのワーカーが、同じ繁殖系統の幼虫を守り続ける。
cards.biology_basis: Clonal workers reproduce by thelytokous parthenogenesis, while policing limits the number of simultaneous reproductives.

options.text: Guard a clonal brood line.

cards.name: 複製狩アリの同期繁殖
cards.text: 繁殖相と幼虫養育・採餌相が、コロニー全体で同期して切り替わる。
cards.biology_basis: Clonal raider ant colonies alternate synchronized reproductive and brood-care or foraging phases.

options.text: Synchronize reproduction and reveal another route.

cards.name: 菌農アリの無性菌園
cards.text: 無性生殖する女王の子である働きアリが、菌園を継続して育てる。
cards.biology_basis: Documented asexual Mycocepurus smithii populations combine thelytokous queen reproduction with obligate fungus farming.

options.text: Harvest a garden maintained by clonal workers.

cards.name: 放浪アリの二型雄
cards.text: 巣に残って争う無翅雄と、飛び立つ有翅雄を同じコロニーで作る。
cards.biology_basis: Cardiocondyla obscurior produces wingless fighter males that remain in the nest and peaceful winged males that can disperse.

options.text: Use winged and wingless males for two reproductive routes.
Open a reproductive alternative.

cards.name: ウメマツアリの三系統繁殖
cards.text: 異なる三つの系統を、ひとつの社会の中で維持する。
cards.biology_basis: Queens and males can be clonally produced from maternal and paternal genomes, while workers are predominantly sexually produced.

options.text: Maintain three reproductive lineages in one colony.

cards.name: アミメアリの単為生殖ワーカー
cards.text: 女王のいない巣で、単型の雌が単為生殖により次の雌を産む。
cards.biology_basis: Queenless colonies contain monomorphic females that first reproduce thelytokously and later perform cooperative work.

options.text: Let a worker carry the colony's reproductive future.

cards.name: 樹脂アリの抗菌巣材
cards.text: 樹脂を巣材に混ぜ、微生物の増殖を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: Formica paralugubris collects conifer resin and places it in the nest, reducing microbial growth.

options.text: Line the nest with antimicrobial resin.

cards.name: 欧州赤アリの葬送分業
cards.text: 死骸を見つけた個体が運び出し、腐敗の広がりを防ぐ。
cards.biology_basis: Myrmica rubra workers detect and remove corpses, limiting the time dead nestmates remain in the colony.

options.text: Remove a dead nestmate before decay spreads.

cards.name: ウシアリの抗菌腺
cards.text: 腺から出る抗菌分泌物を巣材や幼虫の周囲へ塗り、微生物の増殖を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: Myrmecia workers use antimicrobial gland secretions on nest material and brood-associated surfaces.

options.text: Apply gland secretions against microbes.

cards.name: シリアゲアリの粘着腺
cards.text: 粘着性の腺分泌物を攻撃者へ付着させ、動きを妨げる。
cards.biology_basis: Crematogaster workers deploy sticky glandular secretions that impede attacking arthropods.

options.text: Spread a sticky defensive secretion.

cards.name: ツムギアリの毒液噴霧
cards.text: 噛みついた相手へ毒液を吹きかけ、巣へ近づけない。
cards.biology_basis: Weaver ants bite and spray formic-acid-rich venom during attacks on nest enemies.

options.text: Spray venom at an intruder.

cards.name: 樹脂アリの酸性樹脂
cards.text: 針葉樹の樹脂を巣へ運び、働きアリの防御性分泌物と組み合わせる。
cards.biology_basis: Formica paralugubris places conifer resin in the nest, where it acts together with worker chemical defenses.

options.text: Combine resin and defensive acid.

cards.name: ウミトゲアリの偏光眼
cards.text: 空の偏光と視覚情報を使い、樹冠の枝を移動する。
cards.biology_basis: Arboreal Polyrhachis ants use sky polarization and visual cues while moving through the canopy.

options.text: Use polarized light to orient in the canopy.

cards.name: アギトアリの夜間視
cards.text: 発達した複眼で、薄暗い林床でも獲物と障害物を見分ける。
cards.biology_basis: Some trap-jaw ants have enlarged compound eyes adapted for visually guided activity in low light.

options.text: Use enlarged eyes in dim forest light.

cards.name: アカシアリの細脚
cards.text: 細長い脚で細い植物の茎をすばやく走る。
cards.biology_basis: Pseudomyrmex workers have elongated legs and agile bodies suited to rapid movement on vegetation.

options.text: Run along narrow stems with elongated legs.

cards.name: ウシアリの視覚狩り
cards.text: 大きな眼で獲物と目印を追い、視覚的な追跡狩りを行う。
cards.biology_basis: Myrmecia workers rely strongly on visual landmark learning and visual pursuit while hunting.

options.text: Track prey with precise visual pursuit.

cards.name: 黒庭アリの口移し
cards.text: 働きアリ同士が口移しで液体食料を分配する。
cards.biology_basis: Lasius workers distribute liquid food through repeated mouth-to-mouth trophallaxis.

options.text: Share liquid food mouth to mouth.

cards.name: アズテカの空洞巣
cards.text: 植物が作る中空の膨らんだ葉柄を巣室として利用し、宿主植物と共生する。
cards.biology_basis: Azteca alfari colonies inhabit hollow swollen petioles of Cecropia and maintain a plant-ant association.

options.text: Occupy a hollow plant chamber with a host tree.

cards.name: クロアリの自己投薬
cards.text: 病原性の菌にさらされた働きアリが、抗菌性の物質を自ら摂取する。
cards.biology_basis: Formica fusca workers ingest antimicrobial substances when exposed to fungal pathogens.

options.text: Use an antimicrobial substance against infection.

cards.name: ケファロテスハキリアリの抗菌酸
cards.text: 腺分泌物と菌園由来の抗菌物質を使い分け、病原菌の増殖を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: Leafcutter ants use metapleural gland secretions and garden-associated antimicrobial compounds against pathogens.

options.text: Apply metapleural and garden-associated antimicrobials.

cards.name: オオアリの唾液治療
cards.text: 働きアリが抗菌性のある口腔分泌物を仲間の傷へ塗る。
cards.biology_basis: Camponotus workers use antimicrobial compounds in oral secretions during social wound care.

options.text: Coat a wound with antimicrobial oral fluid.

fallback_options.text: Clean a wound with oral fluid.

cards.name: ハキリアリのフェニル酢酸
cards.text: 後胸腺からフェニル酢酸を分泌し、菌園の病原菌へ作用させる。
cards.biology_basis: Acromyrmex metapleural glands produce phenylacetic acid with antifungal activity.

options.text: Release phenylacetic acid against garden pathogens.

cards.name: ハキリアリの硬質顎
cards.text: 分化した大顎で葉を切り、菌園へ運べる大きさに加工する。
cards.biology_basis: Atta workers use differentiated mandibles to cut leaves and process plant material for the fungus garden.

options.text: Cut and process tough plant material.

fallback_options.text: Cut a small piece of leaf material.

cards.name: オオズアリの咬合筋
cards.text: 兵隊の大きな頭部と咬筋が、強い噛みつきの力を生む。
cards.biology_basis: Pheidole soldiers have enlarged head and mandibular musculature that produces powerful bites.

options.text: Drive a powerful defensive bite.

cards.name: 砂走アリの単眼航法
cards.text: 発達した単眼で偏光した空を読み、開けた地面を進む。
cards.biology_basis: Melophorus bagoti uses polarized skylight and visual landmarks to navigate over open Australian ground.

options.text: Read polarized skylight through enlarged ocelli.

cards.name: ムネボソアリの体格分業
cards.text: 体格の異なる働きアリが、採餌や育児など異なる仕事を分担する。
cards.biology_basis: Temnothorax colonies contain workers of variable size whose morphology is associated with task performance.

options.text: Deploy size-diverse workers for different tasks.

fallback_options.text: Use one worker size for a simple task.

cards.name: 収穫アリの種子選別
cards.text: 集めた種子を大きさや硬さで選り分け、発芽した種子も加工する。
cards.biology_basis: Pogonomyrmex workers sort and process collected seeds, including germinated seeds and hard seed types.

options.text: Sort seeds by size and processability.

cards.name: オオアリの断脚治療
cards.text: 重い傷を負った脚を仲間が処置し、感染が広がる前に切断することがある。
cards.biology_basis: Camponotus floridanus workers treat severe injuries with wound care and, in some cases, limb amputation.

options.text: Remove a damaged limb before infection spreads.

cards.name: ハキリアリの換気塔
cards.text: 地下巣の開口部に土の塔を築き、巣内の空気交換を助ける。
cards.biology_basis: Workers construct ventilation turrets above nest openings; turret aperture and opening number change with elevated nest CO2.

options.text: Build a ventilation turret over the nest opening.

cards.name: ハキリアリの隔離廃棄室
cards.text: 廃菌床や死骸を専用の地下室へ集め、生活域と菌園から隔離する。
cards.biology_basis: Derived Atta species commonly isolate refuse in underground waste chambers, spatially separating contaminated material from the rest of the nest.

options.text: Isolate contaminated refuse in a dedicated chamber.

cards.name: 収穫アリの入口ハブ
cards.text: 入口直下の部屋へ採餌個体を集め、出入りと情報交換の流れを集中させる。
cards.biology_basis: The entrance chamber forms a hub in the nest architecture where interactions regulate whether foragers leave on another trip.

options.text: Route returning and outgoing foragers through the entrance hub.

cards.name: メリソタルスの生木坑道
cards.text: 生きた木を削り抜き、樹皮の下へ閉鎖的な坑道網を広げる。
cards.biology_basis: Workers have extreme head, mandible and leg adaptations for tunnelling through healthy living wood and live almost entirely within their galleries.

options.text: Excavate a permanent gallery network through living wood.

cards.name: クロクサアリの菌糸段ボール巣
cards.text: 木片や分泌物を菌糸で結び、巣壁を補強する複合建材を作る。
cards.biology_basis: Workers build carton nests from wood particles and binders reinforced by fungal mycelium, producing a durable living composite nest material.

options.text: Reinforce the nest with fungus-bound carton.

fallback_options.text: Patch the nest wall with loose plant material.

cards.name: アロメルスの菌糸トラップ回廊
cards.text: 植物毛と菌糸で穴だらけの回廊を築き、内部から大型の獲物を待ち伏せする。
cards.biology_basis: Workers construct galleried ambush platforms from host-plant hairs reinforced by fungal mycelium, then collectively immobilize prey through openings.

options.text: Ambush large prey through the fungal gallery openings.

cards.name: ヤマアリの茅葺き温室巣
cards.text: 植物片を厚く積んだ巣丘で断熱と蓄熱を行い、育児域の温度を安定させる。
cards.biology_basis: Wood ants build large thatch mounds whose architecture and nest material provide insulation, heat storage and stable brood microclimates.

options.text: Maintain a stable brood microclimate inside the thatch mound.

fallback_options.text: Pile loose plant fragments around the nest.

cards.name: 収穫アリの年齢分業
cards.text: 若い働きアリは育児など巣内の仕事を担い、年齢とともに巣の維持、パトロール、採餌へ移る。
cards.biology_basis: Workers show temporal polyethism: younger workers perform brood care inside the nest, then shift through nest maintenance and patrolling toward outside foraging as they age.

options.text: Allocate workers among age-related tasks.

on_pushed_out.text: 老齢ワーカーが危険な巣外採餌を担い、最後の働きを繁栄へ変える。

cards.name: グンタイアリの生体橋
cards.text: 働きアリ自身が連結して隙間を渡す橋となり、交通量に応じて橋の規模を調節する。
cards.biology_basis: Army ants form self-assembled bridges whose geometry changes with traffic and the cost of removing workers from the foraging force.

options.text: Form a living bridge whose value rises with colony scale.

cards.name: グンタイアリの生体路面
cards.text: 小さな働きアリが採餌路の穴へ体をはめ、後続個体が平らに通れる路面を作る。
cards.biology_basis: Workers plug potholes in trails with their own bodies, improving traffic flow for nestmates carrying loads.

options.text: Fill trail defects with worker bodies.

cards.name: グンタイアリの生体野営地
cards.text: 固定巣を作らず、大量の働きアリが互いに連結して女王と幼虫を包む一時的な巣を形成する。
cards.biology_basis: Army-ant colonies construct temporary bivouacs from the interlocked bodies of workers rather than a permanent built nest.

options.text: Form a defensive living bivouac.

cards.name: グンタイアリのコロニー分裂
cards.text: 女王が単独で創設せず、大量の働きアリを伴って成熟コロニーから分かれ、新しい群れを作る。
cards.biology_basis: Army ants establish daughter colonies by colony fission, with queens accompanied by substantial worker forces.

options.text: Propagate through colony fission.

cards.name: ハキリアリの糞液酵素循環
cards.text: 菌が作った植物分解酵素を消化せず糞液へ濃縮し、新しい葉片へ再び塗布して利用する。
cards.biology_basis: Fungal pectinases and other plant-degrading enzymes pass through the ant gut and remain active in fecal droplets applied to fresh garden substrate.

options.text: Recycle fungal enzymes onto fresh substrate.

fallback_options.text: Process fresh leaf substrate without efficient enzyme recycling.

cards.name: ハキリアリ菌園の窒素固定
cards.text: 菌園の微生物群が窒素の乏しい植物資源を補い、長期的な栄養不足を緩和する。
cards.biology_basis: Leaf-cutting ant fungus gardens contain nitrogen-fixing bacteria and operate in a nitrogen-limited nutritional mutualism.

options.text: Buffer poor plant nutrition through garden-associated nitrogen input.

fallback_options.text: Rely on the nitrogen already present in collected vegetation.

cards.name: オオアリの女王卵認証
cards.text: 卵表面の女王由来炭化水素を手掛かりに、繁殖由来を識別する。
cards.biology_basis: Queen-derived cuticular-hydrocarbon signals on eggs contribute to recognition and reproductive policing in mature colonies.

options.text: Use queen-associated egg chemistry to stabilize reproduction.

cards.name: ハキリアリの幹線道路
cards.text: 林床を継続的に整備して広い採餌道路を作り、大量の葉片輸送を支える。
cards.biology_basis: Leaf-cutting ants maintain extensive cleared trail networks whose construction cost is repaid by high-volume transport.

options.text: Maintain a cleared trunk trail.

cards.name: アシナガキアリの集団運搬
cards.text: 複数個体で大きな餌を運ぶが、集団が過大になると障害物への応答が鈍る。
cards.biology_basis: Cooperative transport benefits from group force but overly large carrying groups can lose maneuverability and responsiveness.

options.text: Cooperatively haul a large food item.

cards.name: オオアリの発生制御口移し
cards.text: 口移し液に含まれる発生調節物質が幼虫の発育と成体形質へ影響する。
cards.biology_basis: Trophallactic fluid contains juvenile hormone and other molecules that can alter larval development and adult size.

options.text: Use developmental plasticity when no specialized environmental route exists.

cards.name: オオアリの栄養共生菌
cards.text: 細胞内共生菌Blochmanniaが尿素由来窒素を再利用し、必須アミノ酸を補う。
cards.biology_basis: Blochmannia nutritionally upgrades poor diets by essential-amino-acid synthesis and nitrogen recycling through urease.

options.text: Upgrade nitrogen-poor food through Blochmannia metabolism.

fallback_options.text: Use available dietary nitrogen without microbial upgrading.

cards.name: アカシアリの防衛契約
cards.text: 宿主植物から食料と住居を得る代わりに、植食者を攻撃して宿主を守る。
cards.biology_basis: Obligate acacia ants occupy host domatia and aggressively defend host plants against herbivores.

options.text: Defend the host plant that feeds and houses the colony.

fallback_options.text: Exploit a plant resource without dedicated host defense.

cards.name: ヤマアリのアブラムシ牧畜
cards.text: アブラムシを継続的に利用し、蜜露という安定した糖資源を得る。
cards.biology_basis: Ants tend aphids for honeydew and can protect their trophobionts from enemies and disease-associated threats.

options.text: Maintain a dependable honeydew livestock resource.

cards.name: アメイロアリの液体運搬道具
cards.text: 土粒や葉片などを液体食へ浸し、吸収させて巣へ持ち帰る。
cards.biology_basis: Workers use absorbent materials as tools to transport liquid foods that are difficult to carry directly.

options.text: Use absorbent tools to exploit awkward liquid resources.

cards.name: ムネボソアリのタンデム教育
cards.text: 経験個体が追従個体の歩調に合わせ、餌場や新しい場所への経路を学習させる。
cards.biology_basis: Tandem running transfers route information from an informed leader to a follower in a teaching-like interaction.

options.text: Teach a route more efficiently when sacrificing retention for exploration.

cards.name: ハキリアリの摩耗顎転職
cards.text: 葉切りで摩耗した大顎を持つ老齢ワーカーが、切断より運搬へ仕事を移す。
cards.biology_basis: Mandible wear reduces cutting performance and older workers can shift toward transport rather than leaf cutting.

options.text: Reassign worn cutters to transport.

on_pushed_out.text: 摩耗した切断個体が運搬へ転職し、最後まで資源回収に貢献する。

cards.name: ハキリアリの巨大コロニー分業
cards.text: 巨大コロニーで異なる体格のワーカーが発達し、切断・運搬・防衛などに適した身体形態を持つ。
cards.biology_basis: Across ants, larger colonies are associated with the evolution of greater worker-size diversity and physically differentiated castes.

options.text: Develop strongly differentiated worker body forms.

cards.name: 砂漠アリの高脚
cards.text: 長い脚で体を熱い地表から離し、高温下でも高速で移動する。
cards.biology_basis: Long legs elevate the body above hot ground and support rapid locomotion in desert heat.

options.text: Stride above the hottest boundary layer.

cards.name: トゲアリの外骨格棘
cards.text: 胸部や腹柄の長い棘が捕食者につかまれにくくし、防御力を高める。
cards.biology_basis: Experimental spine removal reduces defense against predators, supporting a direct defensive role for long cuticular spines.

options.text: Make the body difficult for predators to seize.

cards.name: ドラクラアリの幼虫血リンパ
cards.text: 幼虫を殺さず表皮へ小さな傷をつけ、血リンパを栄養源として利用する。
cards.biology_basis: Queens and workers can feed on larval hemolymph without killing larvae, which may later continue development.

options.text: Tap brood hemolymph as an emergency internal resource.

fallback_options.text: Use ordinary prey and brood food.

cards.name: アクロピガのカイガラムシ携行
cards.text: 新女王が巣を出る際に共生カイガラムシを運び、新しい巣へ食料源を持ち込む。
cards.biology_basis: Queens transport obligate trophobiotic scale insects during dispersal so the mutualism is established in the new nest.

options.text: Carry a trophobiont into the next nest.

cards.name: オオアリの尿素採餌
cards.text: 尿や尿素を含む資源を積極的に利用し、共生代謝へ窒素を取り込む。
cards.biology_basis: Carpenter ants can be attracted to urea-containing resources, while Blochmannia can recycle urea nitrogen into amino-acid metabolism.

options.text: Exploit unusual nitrogen-rich excretions.

cards.name: アリの種子散布
cards.text: 脂質に富むエライオソームを持つ種子を運び、可食部を利用した後に種子を捨てる。
cards.biology_basis: Many ants collect elaiosome-bearing seeds, consume the reward and disperse intact seeds away from the parent plant.

options.text: Harvest elaiosomes while dispersing intact seeds.

cards.name: ヒアリのソレノプシン
cards.text: 毒液アルカロイドを攻撃・防衛にも抗菌にも利用する。
cards.biology_basis: Fire-ant venom alkaloids have both defensive/toxic and antimicrobial activity.

options.text: Use solenopsin against attackers.
Use solenopsin against microbial threats.

cards.name: ヒアリの抗菌土壌選択
cards.text: 新女王が病原菌の少ない微生物相を持つ土壌を選び、創設巣の感染リスクを下げる。
cards.biology_basis: Founding queens are attracted to soil cues associated with actinobacteria-rich, pathogen-suppressive soils.

options.text: Choose a microbially safer founding soil.

cards.name: キイロケアリの地下アブラムシ牧場
cards.text: 地下室で根アブラムシを維持し、蜜露とタンパク質の両方を安定利用する。
cards.biology_basis: Colonies tend root aphids underground and exploit them as long-term honeydew and nutritional resources.

options.text: Maintain a protected underground livestock system.

cards.name: クレマトガスターの宿主剪定
cards.text: 宿主植物周辺の競争植物を切り払い、営巣植物の成長空間を確保する。
cards.biology_basis: Some plant-ants prune encroaching vegetation around host plants, improving access to and persistence of their nesting resource.

options.text: Prune competing vegetation around the host.

fallback_options.text: Use the host without active pruning.

cards.name: オオアリの酸性胃袋
cards.text: 毒腺由来の蟻酸を飲み込み、口移し前の液体食を強く酸性化して病原細菌を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: Formicine ants swallow their own formic acid, acidifying the crop and suppressing food-borne pathogens.

options.text: Acidify stored liquid food before sharing it.

fallback_options.text: Store liquid food without strong acidification.

cards.name: カメアリの窒素排泄物採餌
cards.text: 鳥糞や尿など窒素を含む排泄物を資源として利用する。
cards.subject_taxon: Cephalotes spp. and other arboreal ants
cards.biology_basis: Arboreal ants exploit nitrogen-rich excreta, while turtle-ant gut symbionts recycle nitrogen from nitrogen-poor diets.

options.text: Exploit nitrogen-rich excreta unavailable to many competitors.

cards.name: ヤマアリの蟻酸噴射
cards.text: 腹端から蟻酸を噴射し、接近する捕食者や敵個体を退ける。
cards.biology_basis: Formicine ants discharge formic acid through the acidopore as a potent defensive chemical weapon.

options.text: Spray formic acid at an approaching threat.

cards.name: オオアリモドキの防御毒
cards.text: 強い痛覚性毒を刺針から注入し、大型の敵を退ける。
cards.biology_basis: Bull-ant venom strongly activates vertebrate sensory neurons and functions in predation and defense.

options.text: Deliver a highly painful defensive sting.

cards.name: テトラポネラの宿主防衛毒
cards.text: 宿主植物へ侵入する植食者を毒針で攻撃し、営巣植物を守る。
cards.biology_basis: Plant-ant venom is effective against herbivores and serves host-plant defense rather than merely prey capture.

options.text: Sting herbivores attacking the host plant.

fallback_options.text: Defend the host with ordinary aggression.

cards.name: アファエノガスターの幼虫緊急退避
cards.text: 巣内へ特殊な捕食者が侵入すると、幼虫と蛹を巣外へ搬出して被害を避ける。
cards.biology_basis: Colonies can specifically evacuate brood in response to an ant-eating snake invading the nest.

options.text: Evacuate brood before the predator reaches the nursery.

fallback_options.text: Move only part of the brood.

cards.name: オオアリの二重警報
cards.text: 警報フェロモンと巣材を伝わる振動を組み合わせ、脅威への反応を切り替える。
cards.biology_basis: Chemical alarm cues and substrate-borne vibrations jointly alter worker movement and defensive responses.

options.text: Combine chemical and vibrational alarm channels.

cards.name: ケアリの感染蛹破壊
cards.text: 感染した蛹を化学的に検知し、繭と表皮を破って抗菌毒を内部へ入れる。
cards.biology_basis: Workers detect infected pupae and perform destructive disinfection, opening the cocoon and applying antimicrobial poison to stop pathogen growth.

options.text: Destroy an infected pupa before it becomes a fungal reservoir.

cards.name: ヒアリ女王の毒液卵コーティング
cards.text: 女王が毒液アルカロイドを卵表面へ付着させ、微生物の増殖を抑える。
cards.biology_basis: Fire-ant venom alkaloids have antimicrobial properties and are deposited on eggs during oviposition.

options.text: Coat eggs with antimicrobial venom alkaloids.

cards.name: ムネボソアリの感染自己隔離
cards.text: 致死的な真菌感染を受けた働きアリが自発的に巣を離れ、外で単独死する。
cards.biology_basis: Lethally infected workers leave the nest and die in isolation, reducing the chance of transmitting infection to nestmates.

options.text: Remove the infectious body from the colony before death.

schema_extensions.size_effects: For size-dependent cards, values for Small/Medium/Large/Giant replace the corresponding base option values for that size.
schema_extensions.vulnerabilities: Each entry increases the named problem shortfall as if shield were reduced by that amount; used for sanitation risk of very large/high-density colony traits.
schema_extensions.environment_prosperity_loss_reduction: Reduce prosperity loss caused directly by the current environment by this amount, minimum 0. Does not reduce the standard 2^n raid/sanitation penalty unless that penalty is explicitly an environment prosperity modifier.
schema_extensions.prosperity_if_environment_has_no_optimiz: Use this prosperity instead of the normal prosperity when the current environment has zero optimization routes.
schema_extensions.candidate_bonus_when_reduce_retention_fo: Adds this many candidates when using the existing rule that reduces retention by 1 to see 2 additional candidates.
schema_extensions.on_pushed_out: Resolve once when this card is pushed out of a depth-5 column.

balance_notes.existing_shield3_pass: Existing options with prosperity 5 and shield 3 were reduced to prosperity 3.
balance_notes.new_shield3_standard: New completed cards with shield 3 are generally prosperity 3, with fallback around shield 1.

balance_notes.v0.16_requirement3_shield3: 要求合計3＋シールド3は原則シールド2へ。ただし形態3要求のサシハリアリの強毒は形態供給の薄さを考慮し据え置き。
balance_notes.v0.16_completed_form_rule: 完成形は繁栄値だけで終わらせず、生態に沿ったシールド・環境軽減・その他の固有効果を持たせる。
balance_notes.v0.16_morphology_weight: 形態要求は序盤の形態供給が薄いことを考慮し、同じ要求合計でもやや強い報酬を許容する。
